known_limitations: No volume, difficulty or CPC data for any keyword.
The ETH page fetch returned only head meta tags, so its actual features were not read; product scope comes from that metadata and from your CyberEDT notes.
Keywords are researcher-derived; most were not observed as queries.
Search results were not geo-targeted; India evidence is minimal.
Competitor pricing and free tiers were not verified; several facts come from third-party listings.
Red/blue team terms are crowded by funded platforms; fit with ETH unverified.

score_method.priority_rules: no sources -> research_required; P0 needs score>=70, relevance>=4, satisfy>=4, cluster eth_attack_chain; P1 score>=58 relevance>=3 satisfy>=3; P2 score>=40; else research_required
score_method.missing_data_treatment: Unverified demand scores 0; 2+ external independent pages (own-site meta excluded) give a capped qualitative signal of 2 of 5.
